findings.reason: as written the node's gate passes with the retry-once clause unimplemented, so the plan should add a case for a vanished target (or drop the clause), otherwise the deliverable states a behaviour nothing measures.
findings.text: §44's Deliverable requires "A materialiser that still meets a vanished target retries once before deferring", but none of the three done-when cases exercises a vanished target or a retry, so the gate cannot show that requirement holds
